fields.name: duration
fields.tooltip: How long the shake lasts, in seconds.

fields.name: positionAmplitude
fields.tooltip: Maximum positional offset in local units.

fields.name: frequency
fields.tooltip: How fast the shake oscillates. Higher = buzzier, lower = heavier.

fields.name: falloff
fields.tooltip: Amplitude over the shake's normalized lifetime (1 at start, 0 at end for a natural decay).
